create_minihackroom_env: create a MiniHackRoom environment with custom size, monsters, traps, and lighting settings
build_minihackroom5x5_variant: build a MiniHackRoom5x5 variant environment with random goals, darkness, monsters, or traps
build_minihackroom15x15_variant: build a MiniHackRoom15x15 variant environment with random goals, darkness, monsters, or traps
register_minihack_env: register a new MiniHack room environment variant using the register function with an id and entry point
run_minihack_navigation_task: run a MiniHack navigation task by instantiating a registered room environment and stepping through episodes
